scenes.say: Stacks, queues, and deques—what sets them apart, and why do they matter in interviews?
Stacks use last-in, first-out. Queues use first-in, first-out. Deques let you add or remove from either end.

scenes.question: Which structure for BFS and DFS?
scenes.wrong: Stacks for BFS, queues for DFS
scenes.right: Stacks are used for depth-first search, queues for breadth-first search.
scenes.say: Don’t mix up stacks and queues: stacks are for depth-first search, queues are for breadth-first search.
